mastering: Floor-ready mastered cues; routine interface and destructive-action cues are intentionally restrained below scan, outbound, and fault cues.

scan_success.label: Successful item scan
scan_success.description: A light two-part confirmation for normal accepted item scans. Page navigation is intentionally silent.

reserved_scan_success.label: Reserved success cue
reserved_scan_success.description: The former scan-success composition is intentionally retained in the sound pack but is not currently mapped in the web app.

rack_barcode.label: Rack barcode accepted
rack_barcode.description: A compact mechanical barcode snap and rack-specific confirmation, distinct from normal item scans.

rack_outbound.label: Outbound rack released
rack_outbound.description: A rising airy departure swoosh followed by a success chime when a rack is sent on the way.

destructive_action.label: Clear, reset, remove, or delete completed
destructive_action.description: A restrained downward wipe and settle cue used only after destructive actions finish successfully.

collapse_open.label: Section expanded
collapse_open.description: A small, subtle upward windy swoosh for expanding Scan and Bay Map sections.

collapse_close.label: Section collapsed
collapse_close.description: A small, subtle downward windy swoosh for collapsing Scan and Bay Map sections.

scan_duplicate.label: Duplicate/already scanned
scan_duplicate.description: A gentle repeated confirmation that says the scan was heard but no state changed.

scan_warning.label: Warning or override required
scan_warning.description: A controlled descending caution phrase that is distinct without sounding like failure.

scan_error.label: Rejected or invalid scan
scan_error.description: A low two-part industrial rejection cue that remains clear without becoming a buzzer.

scan_rush.label: Successful Rush scan
scan_rush.description: The signature success sound with a high-priority sparkle that can be recognized instantly.

scan_remake.label: Successful remake scan
scan_remake.description: A bright success cue with a restrained glass-like shimmer for remake identification.

task_complete.label: 100% progress or major task completion
task_complete.description: A confident four-note ascending completion phrase with a polished final resonance.

rack_item_added.label: Item added or assigned to rack
rack_item_added.description: A short mechanical latch followed by a clean confirmation.

rack_complete.label: Rack completed
rack_complete.description: A satisfying three-stage industrial lock-in sound.

rack_reopened.label: Rack reopened / Not On The Way
rack_reopened.description: A reverse-release sweep followed by an open-state confirmation.

rack_returned.label: Rack returned and cleared
rack_returned.description: A contained release-and-settle cue for rack reuse.

bay_assigned.label: Item assigned or scanned into a bay
bay_assigned.description: A precise placement click with a clean glass-like confirmation.

bay_removed.label: Item scanned out or released from a bay
bay_removed.description: A short release cue that moves downward and away.

bay_moved.label: Item moved between bays
bay_moved.description: A directional slide followed by a placement confirmation.

undo.label: Undo completed
undo.description: A reverse sweep with a soft descending endpoint.

redo.label: Redo completed
redo.description: A forward sweep with a clear ascending endpoint.

import_start.label: Delivery-list import started
import_start.description: A compact rising pulse that signals work is underway.

import_complete.label: Import completed successfully
import_complete.description: A three-note completion phrase that is shorter than a full-truck celebration.

print_ready.label: Print completed
print_ready.description: A subtle feed-and-click confirmation played after the browser reports that printing has completed.

email_sent.label: Email sent
email_sent.description: An outgoing sweep followed by a concise delivered confirmation.

logout.label: Sign-out
logout.description: A quiet descending close that does not resemble an error.

notification.label: Navigation and application notification
notification.description: A light two-part ping used for page changes, normal accepted scans, and informative notifications.

permission_denied.label: Permission denied
permission_denied.description: A firm low refusal cue reserved for access-control failures.

machine_scan.label: Future machine-generated scan accepted
machine_scan.description: A compact electromechanical pulse distinct from handheld scanning.

machine_fault.label: Future machine fault
machine_fault.description: A controlled industrial fault signal that is forceful without becoming a piercing alarm.
